title: ISC2 Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (CGRC)
releaseBlockers: COBIT, ISO/IEC 27001 and 42001, PCI DSS and FedRAMP rest on the outline or a home page only: find open sources or drop them
description: ISC2 CGRC: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
notice: ISC2, CGRC, CC and CBK are registered marks of ISC2, Inc. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by ISC2, Inc. It contains no ISC2 exam content and is not built from ISC2 study materials.

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 636 cards against the NIST publications and US law they quote, found word for word by the card checker, including the SP 800-60 figure
checks.result: No wrong answers. Eight cards that repeated ISC2 CC cards were deleted, a card testing FedRAMP's service counts (which change every few weeks) was cut, the FedRAMP primers were re-sourced to 44 U.S.C. 3608, and 1 ambiguous card, 1 unsupported claim, 7 unclear cards and 19 minor issues were fixed.
